purpose: Prevent invalid proportion comparisons by defining exactly what each Blender armature span represents and which external measurements are compatible.
principle: A numerical match is meaningful only when the anatomical landmarks and measurement definition match. Surface, joint-centre, osteometric maximum and radiographic relative lengths are not interchangeable.

humerus_armature.blender_span: GH joint centre to elbow joint centre
compatible_with: surface chains only after explicit landmark offsets

radius_armature.blender_span: radial-head centre/surface region to radial styloid
compatible_with: ANSUR radiale-stylion after matching radial-head landmark definition
3D CT radius length if endpoints match
CT/radiographic ulna spans using matching trochlear/distal landmarks
not_directly_compatible_with: percutaneous ulna length unless endpoint correction is defined

compatible_with: base-to-head CT/radiographic metacarpal length after endpoint review
not_directly_compatible_with: metacarpal relative ray position measured from a common carpal reference

finger_phalanx_armature.blender_span: joint centre to next joint centre / tip station
compatible_with: phalangeal base-to-head length if joint-centre offsets are accounted for
not_directly_compatible_with: surface finger segment length without soft-tissue correction

compatible_with: metatarsal base-to-head bone length after endpoint review
only studies measuring the same landmarks
tarsal_armature.warning: Current tarsal Blender bones are control/reference sticks, not geometric representations of the full tarsal bones.

vertebral_armature.blender_span: inferior-to-superior vertebral body/endplate-centre segment on an interpolated spinal curve
compatible_with: vertebral body height and endplate-centre spacing after verifying whether disc height is included
not_directly_compatible_with: whole motion-segment height unless disc contribution is separated

rib_armature.blender_span: costovertebral region to anterior rib end, currently represented as a straight segment
compatible_with: only straight chord/endpoint studies using equivalent landmarks
rib_armature.warning: A curved centreline/neck-axis model is required before the rib armature can be treated as anatomical rib geometry.

foot_surface_length.measurement: heel skin to longest toe skin

hand_surface_length.measurement: wrist surface station to lowest fingertip skin vertex

interpretation: The current tarsal stick lengths are not valid evidence that the calcaneus or other tarsals are physically that length.
The metacarpal and phalanx armature spans are closer to anatomical segment lengths and can be checked against matching radiographic/CT definitions.
The current foot surface can be too long even while some internal rig-stick lengths are not directly interpretable as osteometric lengths.
Canonical target work must store the measurement definition beside every number.
